# Jaewon Choi

Jaewon Choi is a first-year PhD student in Accounting and Management at Harvard
Business School. He studies managerial accounting, with a focus on compensation
and incentives, corporate disclosure, and corporate governance, using empirical
methods drawn from economics, accounting, and finance.
